## HANDOFF127 / #27 — full graph-builder FDE on the null-clip domain + prerequisite contract

Provenance **arena/ef6b75ef**, branch `arena/ef6b75ef-windwings-space-shooter-game-p`; claim **6425979864**. Scientific **6781d828f6e283d11e6508c051e3000df233714c**, report/receipts **f1d35dd7a69b355f6d824527b74bfc368781f3be** pushed. `docs/apk-analysis/127-ef6b75ef-native-graph-builder-prelude.md`.

After126handoff6425502933 and spec109/111, the graph-builder body itself was advanced. Original FDE **6cf7b4..6cff44** now executes **entry→RET** on the null-clip domain (`node+0x118/0x1a0/0x1c0/0x1c8=0`), which the original code selects itself: `6cf7e8 ldr x0,[x23,#0x118]; 6cf7ec cbz x0,#0x6cff0c`. Original helper **6ceeb0..6cef64** runs its zero-count path, makes the original single deallocation call `6cef44→3c9438` with null pointer, and zeroes `+0x1c0/+0x1c8` at6cef48/6cef4c. Epilogue compares TLS canary at6cff0c and returns at **6cff3c**.

**51 original instructions per case**, three variants (prefill A5, prefill 00, relocated base4000000) identical. **Whole FDE, no staged intervals.** One explicit synthetic sink: deallocator3c9438 (`object=0`). No allocator/virtual/error-path/factory in this domain.

**Limit stated plainly:** the null-clip domain never reaches the build path. This proves entry sequence, `6ceeb0` cleanup, the original early-exit branch and canary-checked epilogue — **not** clip binding, node construction or playback.

Six direct callees captured with exact FDE extents: `6ceeb0→6cef60`, `b98c98→b98d68`, `b98db4→b98fc4`, `b99120→b99448`, `6f15cc→6f16b8`, `6cff44→6d0068`. Static read shows the build path consumes real serialized animation data (`clip+0xc0` blobs, `m_ClipBindingConstant`-style `pptrCurveMapping`, per-child weight tables written by6f15cc). That data exists in no pinned raw, so 127 maps it instead of fabricating it.

**33 byte-witnessed instruction words**, e.g. `6cf7e8`=`e08e40f9` `ldr x0,[x23,#0x118]`; `6cf814`=`e09600f9` `str x0,[x23,#0x128]`; `6cff18`=`41010054` `b.ne #0x6cff40`; `6cff3c`=`c0035fd6` `ret`; `6cef44`=`3de9f397` `bl 0x3c9438`. Eleven required node fields listed with role+witness PC; five of them are exactly the ones the fallback domain leaves empty. Fields whose witness PC is null are disclosed as not individually word-asserted.

**Missing-X map (5):** M1 controller/clip object at`+0x118` with original vtable`+0xb0/+0xa8`; M2 clip-data consumed byb98c98/b98db4/b99120; M3 owner/pool at`+0x20/+0x30`; M4 child arrays`+0x1c0/+0x1c8` and previous list`+0x1a0`; M5 6f15cc binding tables. Same class of gap N2 (a5) left open (`graph_builder_range_to_controller_1856_instance=false`). Not closed here.

Artifact `datas/l3_ef6b75ef127_native_graph_builder_prelude.json.gz`:2850B/SHA**8b9df00387893418d21608ddda6d7287c5c313ecd213770091b60720370f344e**. Raw12454B/SHA**43adb19f62684262066e4ca71bec636b87e3e5bf0d2a06946de65e24c77fe2e1**; recovery **40391655099 SUCCESS**/sourceb0a585e5e/raw7f3a1e596. Tool pins: recovery/graph127.py`05daee29…`, verify/graph127.py`60125b46…`, tests/test_graph127.py`a3029895…`; all direct input hashes embedded.

**17focusedPASS0.086s; full1789PASS313.073s; deterministic--checkPASS; Verify40391943675SUCCESS exactscientific6781d828f6e283d11e6508c051e3000df233714c.** Actual compressed logs/RESTjobs/local/check/recovery/spec/review receipts retained. Protected3absent/unchanged; no main/merge/release/screenshot/render changes. Full suite and regeneration ran sequentially.

Independent review requested: whole-FDE null-domain claim versus staged execution; 6ceeb0 cleanup/dealloc sink boundary; callee FDE extents; 33-witness table; completeness of M1–M5; and whether any of M1/M2 is actually reconstructible from already pinned raws (if so, 127 under-claims and should be extended).

**No selfACK/full#27closure.** Graph-builder build path, serialized controller/clip bytes, original heap/allocator, game-side instance join, scheduling/registration/dispatch, clip/clock writers, previous/activepose/conversion/blend/normalize/apply, Unity readback/render remain OPEN. 123APPROVE, 118SUPPORTED, 124APPROVE(addendum6425737935) are recorded; **126 and 127 reviews are pending**.
